Nora (Sales): Heads-up — Skyline wants a last-minute change to their POC pool dp-33. They want an extra +2 GPUs for a 30h demo starting 2024-10-02T12:00Z. Also need two short-lived scoped keys for their SREs and a one-off POC credit. Can infra + billing confirm?
Diego (Solutions): Quick clarifiers: model & quant, expected concurrency, and do they need guaranteed reservation or best-effort burst?
Ravi (Client-SRE): Running rw-13b-quant, ~200 concurrent, seq ~700. They asked for guaranteed capacity to avoid demo flakiness. No external egress.
Priya (EngInfra): We can create a reservation+annotation so GPUs are non-preemptible for the window. API example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/pools/dp-33/reservations -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_TOKEN" -d '{"reservation_name":"skyline-demo-20241002","gpus":2,"start_time":"2024-10-02T12:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-10-03T18:00:00Z","hard_cap":true}'
Priya (EngInfra): Ops note: if they prefer a burst instead we can do burst_max_gpus=2 for a shorter window; bursts are best-effort and may not be fully satisfied under contention.
Diego (Solutions): Recommend fallback routing to rw-6b-quant for background tasks and enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts to cut token costs. Also suggest autoscaler cooldown 5m and max_inflight to protect latency.
Billing Bot: Quick estimate: 2 GPUs * 30h = 60 GPU-hrs. At $4.75/GPU-hr => $285. We can apply a $300 POC credit. Any extension billed pro-rata.
Priya (EngInfra): For keys we'll create scoped service-account keys with TTL 48h and IP allowlist. CLI: rdw iam create-key --service-account skyline-poc-sre --scopes "dedicated:pool:dp-33" --expires-in 48h --allowed-ips "203.0.113.64/27"
Deploy Bot: Reservation job queued jb-20240920-88. Validating capacity for dp-33.
Deploy Bot: Reservation applied ✅ reservation-id rv-skyline-20241002-01. Scoped keys created skyline-poc-sre-01 / skyline-poc-sre-02 (expire 2024-10-05T12:00:00Z). Audit ticket AT-804 opened. Console events: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/dp-33/events/jb-20240920-88
Ravi (Client-SRE): Keys tested, smoke run passed: p50=230ms, p95=600ms. We'll notify if we need an extension.
Nora (Sales): I'll send the confirmation email with reservation window, key expiry, and credit. Reminder: if they request extension, open ticket referencing reservation-id at least 6 hours before end_time.
Priya (EngInfra): Post-demo we'll revoke keys and attach audit logs. If they later request permanent headroom we can discuss a reserved commitment.
